assistantInboxHeader.title: {name}'s Inbox
assistantInboxHeader.subtitle: Here are all the emails I've received and sent for you.
assistantInboxHeader.usage: {sent, plural, one {# sent} other {# sent}} today · {received, plural, one {# received} other {# received}} today

assistantInboxPage.selectPrompt: Pick an email to read it.
assistantInboxPage.searchEmptyBody: Nothing in this folder matches your search.

inboxEmptyState.inboxBody: Anything sent to {address} lands here, and I read it for you.
inboxEmptyState.shareTipDescription: Copy {address} and give it to the people, newsletters, and receipts you'd rather I handled.
inboxEmptyState.forwardTipDescription: Send a thread from your own inbox, then ask me in chat for the short version.
inboxEmptyState.helloRecipeDescription: I'll write to your own address so you can reply and watch it land here.
inboxEmptyState.helloRecipePrompt: Send a short hello from your inbox address to my personal email so I can reply and see it arrive in your inbox. If you don't know my address, ask me for it first.
inboxEmptyState.sentBody: Every email I send for you is kept here, replies included.
inboxEmptyState.draftRecipeDescription: Tell me who it's for and what to say. I'll show you the draft before it goes.
inboxEmptyState.draftRecipePrompt: I'd like you to send an email from your inbox address. Ask me who it's for and what it should say, show me the draft, and send it once I approve.
inboxEmptyState.replyTipDescription: Open a message there and ask me to reply. The reply is kept in this folder.

assistantInboxUpgradeState.title: Give {name} an inbox
assistantInboxUpgradeState.subtitle: An email address people can write to, and one place to read everything that arrives.
assistantInboxUpgradeState.perkReads: {name} reads, sorts, and replies for you
assistantInboxUpgradeState.perkHistory: Every message kept here, inbox and sent
assistantInboxUpgradeState.perkReadsNoName: Your assistant reads, sorts, and replies for you

assistantInboxSetupCard.title: Assistant Email
assistantInboxSetupCard.subtitle: Set up an email for your assistant.
assistantInboxSetupCard.subtitleChooseHandle: Claim your unique handle and set up your assistant's email.
assistantInboxSetupCard.immutableNotice: The handle becomes your assistant's public handle. You won't be able to change it once set.

assistantInboxRoute.setupIncomplete: The address wasn't created. Try again in a moment.
assistantInboxRoute.replyPrompt: Reply to the email with id {id} in your inbox (from {sender}, subject "{subject}"). Read it with `assistant email download {id}` first, then draft a reply and show it to me before sending.

inboxRailRestore.hiddenNote: Assistant Inbox is hidden from your side menu.
inboxRailRestore.restoredToast: Assistant Inbox is back in your side menu.
